title: STOP Doubting and Worrying: God Wants You To Stand Strong in Faith (Christian Motivation)
paragraphs: doubt is like a thief that sneaks into our minds silently stealing our confidence robbing us of our joy and blessings and leaving behind Shadows of uncertainty so today I just want to encourage you in the Lord to stop doubting I will also pray a powerful prayer with you so stay with us until the end to receive the blessings of this prayer imagine being on a long journey with mountains and valleys twists and turns our walk with God is a lot like

that the mountains are the high moments when we feel closest to God but then there are The Valleys the low points where doubt and questions come creeping in let's look at the Israelites who even after witnessing the powerful miracles of god in Egypt grappled with disbelief and fear at the brink of the promised land the Bible says in Hebrews 3 verses 16 to 19 for who having heard rebelled indeed was it not all who came out of Egypt led by Moses

now with whom was he angry 40 years was it not with those who sinned whose corpses fell in the wilderness and to whom did he swear that they would not enter his rest but to those who did not obey so we see that they could not enter in because of unbelief this scripture isn't just a recounting of historical events it's a mirror reflecting our own struggles with belief then there's the well-known story of Thomas one of the Twelve Disciples who despite

being close to Jesus declared he wouldn't believe in the resurrection until he saw and touched Christ's wounds for himself yet Jesus in his infinite Mercy appeared to Thomas in John 20 verses 27 to 29. the Bible says then he said to Thomas reach your finger here and look at my hands and reach your hand here and put it into my side do not be unbelieving but believing and Thomas answered and said to him my Lord and my God Jesus said to

him Thomas because you have seen me you have believed blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed the scripture shows that moments of Doubt are common to all believers but they also underscore an important truth God remains patient with us he understands our moments of weakness and provides reassurance at the core of our spiritual Quest is the call to rise above these challenging moments to grasp tightly onto the assurances god offers and to stand firm in faith this

isn't a call to ignore our doubts but to face them head on with the word of God as our Guiding Light the Apostle Paul wrote in Romans 10 verse 17. so then faith comes by hearing and hearing by the word of God in other words the more we immerse ourselves in the teachings of the Bible the stronger our foundation of belief becomes our spiritual journey then is not defined by the absence of doubt but by our willingness to confront and overcome

it grounded in the truths from God's word we're called to keep our eyes on the goal to be brave in the face of doubt and to trust God even when the way isn't clear as we are also reminded in Corinthians 5 verse 7. for we walk by faith not by sight so whenever doubt tries to stop us in our tracks we remember the mighty things God has done before we read God's word and we hold on to our faith standing firm

and confident because we know we're part of a story much bigger than ourselves and in this Grand Story faith is our compass guiding us through every Challenge and leading us home now every tree has roots some deep and hidden some just beneath the surface similarly our doubts don't just appear out of nowhere they have roots it is important to understand where our doubts come from so that we can address them at their Source many times these doubts come from being scared

of what's unknown being afraid of getting something wrong facing tough times or simply not knowing enough let's look again at the story of the Israelites wandering in the desert they had seen God's power in Egypt but soon started doubting when they faced challenges in the wilderness they forgot God's promises because they were hungry scared and didn't fully understand God's plan Exodus 16 Verse 3 says and the children of Israel said to them oh that we had died by the hand of

the Lord in the land of Egypt when we sat by the pots of meat and when we ate bread to the full for you have brought us out into this Wilderness to kill this whole assembly with Hunger but knowing where these doubts come from is the key once we spot the root we can start working on it watering it with truth love and understanding turning doubt into strong faith only by confronting and understanding the root of doubt that we can truly

grow in our relationship with God blossoming and trust and confidence in his plan for us then there's a beautiful thing that Jesus once said about faith he mentioned that even if our faith is as Tiny as a mustard seed that's enough to do big things like moving mountains look at what Matthew 17 verses 19 to 20 says then the disciples came to Jesus privately and said why could we not cast it out so Jesus said to them because of your unbelief

for assuredly I say to you if you have faith as a mustard seed you will say to this mountain move from here to there and it will move and nothing will be impossible for you now think about it a mustard seed is Tiny really tiny but once it's planted it grows into a big tree the point here isn't about having huge Faith right from the start it's about having real true faith even if it's small if it's true it can do

wonders just like David he was young and small compared to the Giant Goliath but his genuine faith in God gave him the strength to face and defeat the giant our faith even if small can grow and do big things when it's real and from the heart so let's believe even if it starts small because genuine faith has the power to change everything right now many of us aren't experiencing the Victorious Life we hope for Financial issues strained relationships a lack of

favor illnesses the challenges seem endless but remember faith has the power to move mountains if you're facing an immovable mountain in your life regardless of its nature it's time to examine your faith are doubts creeping in alongside your belief to witness change we must nurture our faith and remove doubt from the equation let's strengthen our faith and watch the mountains in our lives shift let us look at some examples of the faithful persons in the Bible imagine a gallery filled with

portraits of brave souls who faced towering challenges yet never backed down the pages of the Bible are much like this gallery they're adorned with stories of remarkable individuals who despite their own fears and flaws held tight to their faith Abraham for instance was called to journey into the unknown and though he faltered at times he's remembered as a man of unwavering Faith Genesis 15 verse 6. tells us he believed in the Lord and He accounted it to him for righteousness Sarah

despite her old age believed God's promise of a son Moses overwhelmed by the task ahead still led a nation David a young Shepherd stood tall against a giant not because of his strength but because of his faith and Mary a humble girl from Nazareth accepted a Divine calling that would change the world each of these individuals faced real challenges doubts and questions but in every situation they got rid of doubt they ultimately made a choice to trust in the Everlasting Promises

of God their stories Inspire us reminding us that even in our weakest moments if we hold on to faith we too can overcome now imagine journeying through a dense foggy Forest where the path ahead seems unclear you might feel lost even scared right but what if during that Journey a close friend took your hand guiding you assuring you every step of the way that's what God's promise is to us in the midst of Our Lives foggy paths filled with uncertainties and

doubts there's a Beacon of Hope the unwavering promise of God's presence let's reflect on the beautiful words of Jesus in Matthew 28 verse 20. I Am With You Always to the very end of the age those words aren't just a casual statement they're a commitment a guarantee no matter how lonely challenging or daunting our circumstances might become Jesus assures us that he is right there with us we are never truly alone so stop doubting God is with you always even when

we might not recognize or feel his presence God is still reaching out to us longing for a connection ensuring we know he's there the beauty of God's promise extends even further in Psalm 34 Verse 18 we're reminded the Lord is near to the Brokenhearted and saves the crushed in spirit God doesn't just stand by US during the sunny days or the Mountaintop moments he is especially close when we're sad when we're facing trials or when doubts Cloud our minds so in

moments when you feel the weight of the world pressing down when the journey seems too tough remember this God is not a distant figure watching from afar he's right beside you holding your hand cheering you on and guiding you through his promise is not just of a mere presence but of an active loving and comforting companionship Embrace that promise and let it fuel your spirit especially in times of Doubt for in his presence we find strength hope and the unshakable assurance

that we are never alone in his presence there is fullness of joy also apart from growing in faith we can overcome doubt with other spiritual weapons when soldiers March into battle they are equipped with armor and weapons in our spiritual journey the battles are often internal hidden but they are no less real and just like those soldiers we too have been given weapons not of metal or wood but of spirit and Truth Ephesians 6. verse 11. says put on the whole

armor of God but you may be able to stand against The Wiles of the devil then further on in Ephesians 6. verses 14 to 17 the Bible says stand therefore having girded your waist with truth having put on the breastplate of righteousness and having shed your feet with the preparation of the gospel of peace above all taking the shield of Faith with which you will be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked one and take the helmet of

salvation and the sword of the spirit which is the word of God remember Daniel in a kingdom where he could have easily embraced their ways and forget about his God Daniel chose a different path he set his heart on prayer consider that he didn't just give in to the pressure and say oh well I might as well conform so that I stay alive or he didn't say I am going to give up on God because he is taking too long to

deliver me or he didn't say I doubt God will deliver me this time no Daniel didn't do any of that instead even when faced with a decree that could cost him his life Daniel continued praying three times a day and it was this discipline that delivered him from the Lion's Den prayer is also a powerful spiritual weapon against doubt it is our direct line to God a moment of communion where our spirit connects with his fasting is another powerful discipline against

doubt fasting sharpens our spiritual senses helping us to tune into God's voice think of Jesus before starting his ministry in Matthew 4 verses 1 to 2. he fasted for 40 days and nights preparing himself for the challenges ahead reading the Bible is another powerful spiritual weapon as mentioned earlier but it isn't about merely reading the Bible it's about feasting on God's word it's allowing the stories the Psalms the prophecies to mold us to remind us of God's unchanging character some 119.

verse 105. beautifully illustrates this it says your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path another powerful spiritual weapon to help us to overcome is worship it's not just about songs it's an act of surrender acknowledging God's Supremacy when Paul and Silas were imprisoned they sang hymns to God we see this in Acts 16 verse 25. their worship shook the very foundations of the prison leading to their miraculous deliverance we must learn to have faith no

matter what don't let doubt become the distractor that keeps you from achieving your full potential in Christ now at the core of our faith is a beautiful hope a hope not based on wishful thinking but on the most pivotal event in human history the resurrection of Jesus Christ First Corinthians 15 verses 9 to 20 tells us if in this life only we have hope in Christ we are of all men most miserable but now is Christ risen from the dead and

become the first fruits of them that slept every challenge every doubt fades in comparison to this one undeniable truth Jesus defeated death and because he lives we too are offered eternal life and eternal hope Luke 24 verses 13 to 35. tells us about the two men on the road to Emmaus their hearts were heavy their hopes seemingly dashed by Jesus's crucifixion yet as they walked a stranger joined them explaining the scriptures and restoring their hope when they recognized him as the

Risen Christ their despair turned to Joy their doubts to Assurance in the darkest night in the deepest valley of Doubt remember the empty tomb it stands as an everlasting testament to God's power and love whenever doubt tries to overshadow your heart let the hope of Christ's Resurrection light your path this hope does not disappoint because it's rooted in God's unfailing love and the Glorious promise of Life Everlasting my dear friends we have a duty to guard our faith it's like a

flame in the wind if we don't protect it it might go out but if we shelter it feed it and give it what it needs it'll grow stronger and brighter we may not all face the same valleys but we all have challenges and sometimes experience moments of doubt before we can overcome those challenges so remember the words of Paul in Ephesians 6 verses 10 to 11. finally my brethren be strong in the Lord and in the power of His might put

on the whole armor of God that you may be able to stand against The Wiles of the devil let's make a promise to ourselves and to God to stand strong to never give up and to always keep our faith burning bright because with God on our side we can face any giant or challenge that comes our way stop doubting and trust God now to all those within the sound of my voice let us go to the Lord in prayer I want

you to pray this prayer with me so that you can have all the blessings of this prayer let us pray to our gracious and loving God Heavenly Father the creator of the universe and the source of all life I praise your holy name in the name of Jesus I declare that doubt has no place in my life I command every seed of unbelief to leave and never return in the name of Jesus I rebuke every spirit that seeks to shake my

faith tries to Cloud My Clarity or waver my trust Lord every thought and feeling that is not of you I cast it out in Jesus name father you've called me to trust in you to stand unwavering in my faith despite the storms I pray for strength to hold on to this Faith to stay rooted in your promises and to remain unshaken in the face of Trials Empower me dear Lord to have genuine faith even if it starts as small as a

mustard seed as I stand in Faith Lord I declare in the name of Jesus that no weapon that is formed against me shall prosper in the name of Jesus I declare that all weapons of Doubt worry fear anxiety depression and stress are powerless against me I release all doubt and I embrace your healing protection and Abundant Blessings in my life I bring my loved ones before you Lord you know them more than I do you know their valleys and their challenges

Lord help them to overcome and stand Victorious I pray that they too will be strengthened in their faith and give you all the glory I ask Lord that you instill in them the desire to seek you more Lord as I say this prayer together with everyone listening I am grateful for all the hearts that are opening to you right now I pray that each soul today will grow stronger in faith be more steadfast in belief and remains Anchored In Your Love

Lord may we stop doubting and start trusting you father May doubt be replaced by unwavering trust and let every heart be filled with the hope and assurance that comes from knowing you I thank you for being our Rock our shield and our refuge Lord may you comfort us and lead us through your holy spirit thank you Lord for hearing and answering my prayer in the name of Jesus I pray amen if you were blessed by this message type the word amen

in the comments section below I declare that all the blessings of this prayer are now upon you in the name of Jesus you can help us to reach more persons and spread the gospel you can do this by sharing the video with a friend or family member who you know need the blessing of this prayer and by clicking the like button also remember to subscribe to the channel for more videos that will bless your heart and uplift your spirit we appreciate

all those who support us you're blessed to be a blessing please feel free to leave your prayer request in the comments section so that we can present them before God for your blessings and victory also we invite other believers on the YouTube platform and all over the world to join us and start praying for you right now and we want you to know that even if you don't see a reply to your prayer request it doesn't mean that you were not

prayed for rest assured that we are actively lifting up each request to God that is according to his will we believe in the power of prayer to bring Comfort healing and guidance in accordance with God's perfect plan stand in faith with us while we pray to God be all the glory May the grace and peace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all thank you
